## Summary

Assistant Professor of Economics working at the intersection of behavioural economics, environmental economics, and public policy. Research focuses on sustainability transitions, technology adoption, and climate resilience in emerging economies using causal inference, discrete choice experiments, and large-scale primary surveys. Published in ABDC A and Scopus Q1 journals, with experience in externally funded research, executive education, and policy engagement.

## Research areas

Development Economics, Behavioural Economics, Environmental Economics, Public Policy
